source_data.desc: Your magic haunts the dreams of others. Choose a sleeping creature that you are aware of within range. Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves, can’t be targeted. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it garners no benefit from the rest, and when it awakens, it gains one level of exhaustion and is afflicted with short‑term madness.
source_data.higher_level: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 3rd.

en.description: Your magic haunts the dreams of others. Choose a sleeping creature that you are aware of within range. Creatures that don’t sleep, such as elves, can’t be targeted. The creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or it garners no benefit from the rest, and when it awakens, it gains one level of exhaustion and is afflicted with short‑term madness.
en.name: Sleep of the Deep

ru.description: Ваша магия преследует мечты других. Выберите спящее существо, о котором вы осведомлены в пределах дистанции. Существа, которые не спят, такие как эльфы, не могут быть целью. Существо должно преуспеть в спасброске Мудрости или оно не получает преимущества от отдыха, и когда оно просыпается, оно получает один уровень истощения и поражено краткосрочным безумием.
ru.name: Сон глубин
